meta.title: Northstar Manager Shortlist

signal.label: Not enough manager evidence for a shortlist

limitations: Governed analytical evidence is unavailable in this public sample.

meta.data_scope_banner: Illustrative, Gradient Maintained — demo data, not the client's holdings or managers

executive.bottom_line: No conclusion is possible yet: the comparison, benchmark-relative and robustness results were not returned for the candidates [S1].

sections.title: Executive conclusion
sections.kicker: Evidence does not support a comparative conclusion

blocks.title: Key judgment — Coverage
blocks.text: Observation: Only one of four screening inputs is available [S1]. Why it matters: A shortlist would rest on incomplete data. Uncertainty: Missing reads may change which managers qualify. What would change the view: Complete screening data for every candidate.

blocks.title: Key judgment — Benchmarks
blocks.text: Observation: Benchmark matches are suggested, not confirmed [S1]. Why it matters: Candidates must be compared on the same benchmark. Uncertainty: Mandate fit is unconfirmed. What would change the view: Confirmed benchmark mappings.

blocks.title: Key judgment — Reliability
blocks.text: Observation: Return persistence was not tested [S1]. Why it matters: A shortlist should favor repeatable results. Uncertainty: Persistence is unknown. What would change the view: A robustness run for each candidate.
